030042: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_root_conditional(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, u32* expression_start, u32* question, u32* colon,
030043:                                                u32* expression_end)
030044: {
030045:     while (start < end && c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) &&
030046:            !c_ir_group_is_statement_expression(builder, start, end))
030047:     {
030048:         u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
030049:         if (close != end - 1)
030050:         {
030051:             break;
030052:         }
030053:         start += 1;
030054:         end -= 1;
030055:     }
030056:     u32 found_question = UINT32_MAX;
030057:     u32 nested_questions = 0;
030058:     bool root_assignment = false;
030059:     for (u32 index = start; index < end; index += 1)
030060:     {
030061:         u32 punctuator = builder->preprocess.tokens[index].punctuator;
030062:         CIrGroupScan scan = c_ir_scan_delimiter_group(builder, &index, end);
030063:         if (scan == C_IR_GROUP_SCAN_SKIPPED)
030064:         {
030065:             continue;
030066:         }
030067:         if (scan == C_IR_GROUP_SCAN_UNCLOSED)
030068:         {
030069:             return false;
030070:         }
030071:         if (punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS || punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET || punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE)
030072:         {
030073:             return false;
030074:         }
030075:         if (punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_QUESTION)
030076:         {
030077:             // `lhs = condition ? true_value : false_value` has a
030078:             // conditional operator in the assignment's right operand, not
030079:             // at the root of the expression.  Treating it as a root
030080:             // conditional loses the assignment completion (the Lua
030081:             // luaV_fastgeti macro relies on this exact precedence).
030082:             if (root_assignment)
030083:             {
030084:                 return false;
030085:             }
030086:             if (found_question == UINT32_MAX)
030087:             {
030088:                 found_question = index;
030089:             }
030090:             else
030091:             {
030092:                 nested_questions += 1;
030093:             }
030094:         }
030095:         else if (found_question != UINT32_MAX && punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_COLON)
030096:         {
030097:             if (nested_questions)
030098:             {
030099:                 nested_questions -= 1;
030100:             }
030101:             else
030102:             {
030103:                 if (found_question == start || found_question + 1 == index || index + 1 == end)
030104:                 {
030105:                     return false;
030106:                 }
030107:                 *expression_start = start;
030108:                 *question = found_question;
030109:                 *colon = index;
030110:                 *expression_end = end;
030111:                 return true;
030112:             }
030113:         }
030114:         else if (found_question == UINT32_MAX && c_ir_assignment_operator(builder->preprocess.tokens[index]))
030115:         {
030116:             root_assignment = true;
030117:         }
030118:     }
030119:     return false;
030120: }
